column3: NKJV has “with one accord,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “together.”
NKJV includes “all” and “to one another,” following the Textus Receptus.
NKJV joins “both Jews and proselytes” to verse 10; the critical text places these words in verse 11.
NKJV begins with “Cretans and Arabs,” having placed “both Jews and proselytes” in verse 10.
Close to the Greek; “glorious” is rendered “awesome.”
NKJV includes “you have taken,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “you killed by the hands of lawless men.”
NKJV includes “according to the flesh, He would raise up the Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “to seat one of his descendants on his throne.”
